title.zh-CN: 孕晚期胎动减少 · 29岁女性
title.en: Reduced fetal movements late in pregnancy · woman aged 29

summary.zh-CN: 常规产检时报告胎动减少，需复核胎儿监护、围产期资料和母婴血液检查。
summary.en: Reduced fetal movements are reported at a routine antenatal visit; review fetal monitoring, perinatal records and maternal/infant blood tests.

text.en: Focal infarction involved less than 5% of placental area; some amniotic epithelial degeneration and sparse neutrophils in the membrane/chorionic plate were reported without obvious villous inflammation. The cord had two arteries and one vein, with no tumour.

text.zh-CN: 原报告剖宫产后新生儿接受无创通气、两次红细胞输注及抗感染治疗，Hb先升至74、后121 g/L，呼吸困难改善，约一周后出院；产妇术后恢复良好。未提供长期神经发育随访。
text.en: After caesarean delivery the infant received non-invasive ventilation, two red-cell transfusions and antimicrobial treatment. Haemoglobin rose first to 74 and then 121 g/L, breathing improved and discharge followed about a week later. Maternal postoperative recovery was good; long-term neurodevelopment was not reported.

text.zh-CN: 胎动减少及异常胎监、婴儿重度贫血和母血胎儿红细胞证据支持胎母输血综合征
text.en: Reduced movements and abnormal monitoring, severe neonatal anaemia and fetal-cell evidence in maternal blood support fetomaternal haemorrhage

feedback.zh-CN: 胎儿失血可造成婴儿严重贫血而母亲Hb不低；KB结果需结合母婴临床资料解释。
feedback.en: Fetal blood loss can cause severe infant anaemia without low maternal haemoglobin; KB findings must be interpreted with both clinical records.

text.zh-CN: 母亲血红蛋白正常，所以不可能存在胎儿失血

knowledge.zh-CN: 这是历史病例教学。先核对当前阶段原始证据，再讨论鉴别诊断及安全计划；原报告处置不自动成为今天的推荐。
knowledge.en: This is a historical teaching case. Review evidence for the current phase before discussing differential diagnosis and a safe plan; reported care is not automatically a recommendation for current practice.

conclusion.zh-CN: 报告证据支持胎母输血造成严重胎儿/新生儿贫血；常规产检和母亲Hb正常不能消除当前风险。
conclusion.en: The evidence supports fetomaternal haemorrhage with severe fetal/neonatal anaemia; earlier routine tests and normal maternal haemoglobin do not remove current risk.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 胎监是提示而非本文提供的完整确诊条带。
keyReasoning.en: The described monitoring pattern is a clue, not a complete diagnostic trace supplied by the report.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 阴性Coombs和KB结果应放在同一鉴别诊断链条中。
keyReasoning.en: Negative Coombs and KB findings belong in the same differential diagnostic assessment.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单例观察，不能证明某种治疗的独立疗效或普遍适用性。历史处置仅记录事实；安全决策为教学设计。
boundaries.en: This single observation cannot establish the independent efficacy or general applicability of a treatment. Historical care is recorded as fact; safety decisions are educational design.
